question.text: Will New York City break its record by going more than 332 days without measurable snow?
question.yes:
This question will resolve as "No" if there is measurable snowfall at Central Park (KNYC weather station) at any point between the question's launch and the end of the day on February 4th, 2023. We will rely on New York Metro Weather to supply information about snowfall in Central Park.
This question will resolve as "Yes" if either the New York Times or New York Metro Weather report, via their websites or Twitter accounts, that New York City has broken the record for most days without measurable snowfall.
If there is uncertainty about the resolution, we will defer to public statements from New York Metro Weather and the New York Times.
Only an affirmative statement that New York City has broken the record for snowless days will suffice for a positive resolution. If public statements indicate the city has tied the record, but has not broken it, then the question resolves as "No." If there is no evidence of snow, but Metaculus administrators cannot find affirmative statements that the record has been broken by the time of resolution, then the question resolves as "Ambiguous."
*This question is part of the Beginner Tournament, a set of questions designed to be an introduction to forecasting for those who are relatively new.

question.text: Will GPT-4 input and/or output images? (Input Yes, Output Yes)
question.yes:
The listed option which matches the image input and output capabilities of GPT-4 will resolve as Yes and all others will resolve as No. If OpenAI releases it under a different name but makes it clear that it is also "GPT-4", this would count.
Resolution will be determined according to information provided in the first announcement describing the release of GPT-4 which contains details about the model (for example a blog post would be used while a Tweet or brief press release would not). Capabilities from all described versions or tiers will be used. For example, if a free text-only version is released along with a paid version capable of image input and image generation then GPT-4 would be considered to be capable of both image input and generation. A limited or restricted-access release of GPT-4 will be used for resolution so long as details about the model's capabilities are made public by OpenAI.
If GPT-4 is not released before January 1, 2025, all subquestions resolves as Ambiguous

question.text: Will the Kakhovka dam be breached before May 2023?
question.yes:
The Dnieper, or Dnipro, is a major European river that flows through the middle of Ukraine, discharging into the Black Sea in the South. The Kakhovka dam, about 50 miles upstream of Kherson, interrupts its flow and creates the large Kakhovka reservoir on its upstream side.
As of late October 2022, Russian forces occupied the area of Kherson oblast and the Kakhovka dam, but were not expected to hold for long against the oncoming Ukrainian offensive. As evacuations and military preparations continued, the Russians began accusing the Ukrainian side of plotting to attack the Kakhovka dam, which could cause massive flooding downstream. Some interpreted this as a preparatory move before Russia itself potentially demolished the dam and blamed Ukraine.
Will the Kakhovka dam be breached before 1 May 2023?
Resolves as Yes if the dam suffers a significant breach or failure at any time before 00:00 local 1 May 2023.
Resolves as No if available evidence shows the Kakhovka dam remains intact at 00:00 local time, 1 May 2023, and there are no confirmed reports of a previous significant breach or failure.
A "significant" breach or failure is defined as one that releases at least 0.2 cubic kilometres of water or 1% of the Kakhovka reservoir capacity, whichever is lower.
Metaculus Admins will use their best judgement and the best available sources in determining resolution, including reputable sources such as the Institute for the Study of War and similar analysts, especially those relying on publicly available commercial satellite photos.
